[b]Combat system rules:[/b]
[list][*]Monsters get stronger each level[/*][*]Six lives with 1 totem to defend; if all your lives are used up, or the totem is destroyed, you fail to complete the level[/*][*]The more team members present, the more monsters will appear[/*][*]There are currently no squads in the Celestial Spire Catacombs[/*][*]It is possible to resurrect in a level using a special item[/*][/list]

notes.title: Community Update – Second Half of 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Dear NosPlayers,

Summer is already here, and things are heating up in NosTale! As the days get longer and the temperatures rise, it’s time to reflect on what’s happened so far in 2025 and give you a sneak peek at what’s coming next. From major updates to blazing new servers and exciting plans for the months ahead – let’s dive in!

[h1]A Look Back: January–June 2025[/h1]
[h2]Early Game Rework & Balancing[/h2]
One of the most significant changes this year was our rework of the early game experience. Aimed at improving the onboarding process for new and returning players, this update brought a series of quality-of-life adjustments, revamped quest flows, and combat balancing tweaks to make early-level progression more fluid and enjoyable.

If you haven’t had the chance to check it out yet, we highly recommend taking a look at the [url=https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/2604-game-update-maintenance-19-03-2025/?postID=6060#post6060]patch notes[/url] or diving into the [url=https://nostale.comastuff.com/Early_Game_Rework.pdf]detailed rework document[/url] to get the full picture.

[h2]NosFire Event Server[/h2]
March also saw the launch of [b]NosFire[/b], our limited-time event server filled with explosive action and intense boosts. Players jumped in to enjoy increased EXP and drop rates, unique progression opportunities, and a fast-paced environment that brought a fresh twist to the classic NosTale experience.

NosFire was a hit, and we’re thrilled to see how many of you took part. Whether it was for competitive goals or just to experience the rush, thank you for being part of the fun!

[h1]Looking Ahead: July–December 2025[/h1]
[h2]Server Merge Incoming![/h2]
As you already know by now, one of the first updates planned for the summer is the [b]merge of three major servers: INT-Valehir, DE-Alzanor, and FR-Cosmos[/b]. This merge will bring communities together, strengthen server populations, and create a more dynamic and competitive environment.

[h2]Summer Events – New Raid, New Adventures![/h2]
Our annual summer events return with a splash – not only can you enjoy our usual events to get your hands on hot and cool rewards, but this year, an original new event will also be deployed on our servers bringing a [b]brand-new raid and quests[/b] as well! Expect challenging adventures against the new raid boss, succulent rewards, and all the summer vibes you can get. Prepare your team and dive into this juicy seasonal adventure!

[h2]New Content – Family Celestial Spire[/h2]
Although we announced it for the first half of the year, we were sadly unable to release it on time. However, this time we’re happy to confirm that the Family Celestial Spire is now on track for release. Families will be put to the test with the introduction of the [b]Family Ascension of the Celestial Spire[/b] – a return to the Celestial Spire from Act 7, designed for cooperative gameplay. Climb the tower together, overcome increasingly difficult floors, and earn rewards worthy of your efforts.

[h2]Anniversary Celebrations – New Temporary Celebration Server[/h2]
To mark another year of NosTale, we’re launching a [b]special temporary anniversary server[/b] packed with unique features and limited-time bonuses. Not only will you be able to enjoy the usual birthday events early this year on all servers, but you’ll also receive even more presents on the temporary server. Like NosFire, this server will also allow you to transfer your character at the end of the event – fully prepared for the major content update coming later this year!

Because remember – Christmas is still to come… and if you’re really good, Santa might bring you a really big present.

[h2]Final Words[/h2]
As always, we’d like to thank every one of you for your continued support and feedback. Whether you’ve been here from the start, or are just beginning your journey in NosTale, your passion helps shape the future of the game.

See you in the game!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update – First Half of 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

We’re back with our community update for the first half of 2025!

First, we’d like to wish you a prosperous new year, and a joyful 2025 spent with your loved ones. On our end, we’ll continue working hard to ensure that the content we release in NosTale meets your expectations, making this year one of the most memorable in the game’s history.

Our goal for 2025 is to enhance existing content while also bringing more fun with in-game features that our players cherish, rather than focusing solely on new systems.

But before we dive into what’s coming, let’s take a look back at everything that’s happened over the past six months.

[h2]Hardcore Raids[/h2]
With the introduction of hardcore raids, we’ve released higher-difficulty content tailored to our more experienced players. These raids offer new challenges by presenting multiple harder versions of existing raids.

We’re delighted with how this update has performed and the positive reception from the community. As always, we’ll continue to listen to your feedback and make adjustments where possible to ensure you have an engaging and challenging experience while playing them.

[h2]International Server Merge and Summer Oasis Server[/h2]
In August, we launched a new server designed to improve upon the usual new server you get in summer. Our goal was to provide better levelling and progression, numerous events, extra boosts, and establish INT-Valehir as the destination server to help address depopulation issues.

Initially, there was some confusion, as players expected this server to resemble the NosFire event server introduced a few months earlier. To address this, we made changes by expanding the destination servers and enhancing exclusive features on the Summer Oasis server to better align it with the NosFire experience. These adjustments clearly increased interest in the server, but also discouraged some players from transferring to INT-Valehir.

We’ve taken note of these outcomes, and you can read below to see what we have planned for the near future.

[h2]Act 4 Revamp[/h2]
The most anticipated update we had in store for you this year was the Act 4 overhaul and we hope you’re enjoying the changes we’ve made.Our goal was to revitalise this content, making it more engaging for both PvE and PvP players alike.

We’ll be closely monitoring your feedback over the coming weeks to identify any adjustments that need to be made to ensure this update provides the best possible experience.

[h1]What’s to Come in 2025[/h1]
[h2]Balance Update and Quality of Life Adjustments[/h2]
We regularly hear your requests for more balance updates, and we’re excited to deliver!

With the next balance update, we are planning to focus on the Mystic Arts, Warrior and Sunchaser specialists.

Additionally, we are going to bring some nice quality-of-life improvements inspired by your suggestions on our Discord server. These include individual skill bars and an improved tutorial for new players, which we believe will greatly enhance the experience for beginners.

[h2]New NosFire Servers[/h2]
With the NosFire servers in 2024, we received a lot of positive feedback about this kind of boosted server that made it possible for players to jump right into the higher-level experience, instead of starting from scratch.

Building on that feedback, we’re excited to announce plans for a similar server in the first half of 2025. We’ll be making some adjustments to make it even more enjoyable, so stay tuned for more updates!

[h2]Family Celestial Spire[/h2]
One of the most engaging and unique pieces of content we released in recent years was Act 7’s Celestial Spire. In 2025, we want to explore this concept further, which is why we’re thrilled to announce a new version of the Celestial Spire designed for you to enjoy with your family. 

The specifics of this update are still being finalised, so keep an eye out for more details!

[h2]Summer Raid[/h2]
For some time now, we’ve been hearing your feedback about wanting new seasonal content beyond our regular events for Easter, Summer, Halloween, and others. With this in mind, we have planned with Entwell to work on new concepts for seasonal content in 2025.

You’ll get to experience it this summer with an exciting new event raid. We’ll keep you posted!

[h2]Server Merges[/h2]
We are fully aware of the concerns raised by INT-Valehir players regarding the server’s decreased population. While we’ve tried various methods to attract more players to the server, we recognise that the wait has been long enough. As a result, we will proceed with the much-requested INT-Valehir merge. This server will join the second international cluster alongside DE-Alzanor and FR-Cosmos.

The merge will create a server comparable in size to EU-Dragonveil, ensuring a stable population in the long term. This will provide players worldwide with two optimised servers for a better gameplay experience.

Large servers come with significant technical challenges, which is why we’re taking the time to prepare thoroughly. Once the merge date approaches, we will provide you with all the details.

We hope you’re as excited about this year’s updates as we are! Be sure to share your feedback with us on our usual platforms.Thank you all for making 2024 such an incredible year, and we can’t wait to see you in 2025!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Hardcore Raids & Family Expansion - Patch notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/fa99097d7abbaf7943821e49b54024aa7eb00199.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

A new update has arrived which you’ve all been waiting so long far. We always try to make sure that we release each update to the highest possible quality, which is why it can sometimes take longer than you might prefer.In this update, we’re introducing hardcore versions of existing raids, an expansion to the family system, plus numerous other changes. 

There are hardcore versions for the following raids:

[table][tr][th]Act 1–3 (champion level 30+)[/th][th]Act 5 (champion level 50+)[/th][th]Act 6 (champion level 65+)[/th][th]Act 7 (champion level 80+)[/th][th]Act 8 (champion level 80+)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Mother Cuby[/td][td]Ibrahim[/td][td]Zenas[/td][td]Twisted Spirit King Kirollas[/td][td]Zombie Dragon Valehir[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ginseng[/td][td]Kertos the Demon Dog[/td][td]Erenia[/td][td]Twisted Beast King Carno[/td][td]Ice Dragon Alzanor[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dark Castra[/td][td]Valakus King of Fire[/td][td][/td][td]Demon God Belial[/td][td]Weak Asgobas[/td][/tr][tr][td]Giant Black Spider[/td][td]Fire God Grenigas[/td][td][/td][td]Evil Overlord Paimon[/td][td][/td][/tr][tr][td]Massive Slade[/td][td]Lord Draco[/td][td][/td][td]Revenant Paimon[/td][td][/td][/tr][tr][td][/td][td]Glacerus the Ice Cold[/td][td][/td][td][/td][td][/td][/tr][/table]

Event raids and other temporary raids are not factored into this change, as this would mean players have fewer opportunities to collect the rewards from the current reward system. Similarly, the raids from Act 9 are not in the list as we feel that they are still new enough and do not need a special hardcore version. We may introduce these at a later juncture.

These raids have been chosen so that players have the option of playing older content in a more updated form, and are no longer forced to focus on just 1 or 2 sets of raids.

As with every update, we endeavour to make the gaming experience the best it can possibly be, but we’re also reliant on your feedback. In this update, we’ve added a new feature which will allow us to change the strength of monsters in hardcore raids on the fly, so that we can guarantee a smoother experience for you. 

This means that if certain monsters turn out to be too strong in a raid, we’ll be able to tweak their strength. We’ll take your feedback into account, as well as monitor players’ performance in the game, to make sure the raids remain both challenging and fair.

[b]Hardcore Raids[/b]
[list][*]You earn hardcore raid seals by completing the normal versions of the raids. [/*][*]At the moment there are no restrictions for entering hardcore raids beyond the minimum champion level. [/*][*]Hardcore raids can only be started with a complete team.[/*][*]All hardcore raids have a daily limit.[/*][*]The entry portals are the same as for the regular raids.[/*][*]The raids in Acts 1–3 require champion level 30+, raids in Act 5 champion level 50+, raids in Act 6 champion level 65+, raids in Act 7 champion level 80+, and raids in Act 8 likewise champion level 80+.[/*][*]Raid tokens open up a crafting window where you can craft rewards such as mini-pet versions of the raid bosses, resistances, act-specific materials and more. Mini-pets deal more damage in both the regular and hardcore versions of their raids.[/*][*]In all the major towns like NosVille, Dragonveil and Undercity, there will be a Raid Token Manager who can craft certain items for you like passive medals, perfection stone bags and more. [/*][*]The raid list will display the average champion level of the hardcore raid team.[/*][*]You receive a notification when you’ve inflicted enough damage to receive the rewards.[/*][/list]
[b]The following things change in hardcore raids[/b]
[list][*]Monsters are stronger, depending on the strength of the team.[/*][*]There are 5/8/10 lives depending on the number of raid participants. [/*][*]You only have one life in hardcore raids; if you die twice, you’ll be ejected from the raid.[/*][*]Gold and reputation are awarded depending on the difficulty of the raid, with the gold added directly to your inventory.[/*][*]An additional hardcore token is awarded upon completing a hardcore raid.[/*][*]There is a greater chance to get raid boxes of rarity levels 7 and 8.[/*][*]After completing a raid, the damage statistics of the top three players who inflicted the most damage to the boss will be displayed. The stats are currently only available in hardcore raids, but may be added to normal raids in the future.[/*][*]You must deal a certain amount of damage to the raid boss in order to receive gold, reputation and the hardcore tokens. The raid box however is a guaranteed reward. Since it is more difficult for lower-level players to deal damage, the amount of damage they must inflict is lower than for higher-level players.[/*][*]Raid boxes, special items like Alzanor’s Horn, and big item drops are the same as in normal raids.[/*][/list]
[b]Family Expansion[/b]

notes.title: Community Update – Second Half of 2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Welcome once again to the mid-year community update!

[h1]First Half of 2024: A Review[/h1]

Before sharing what’s coming in the second half of 2024, we would like to discuss our experience with the content launched in recent months. We know that communication is very important to you, a topic we’ve discussed extensively on platforms like Discord. Therefore, we want to expand these biannual updates with more information about our most relevant projects.

[h2]Act 9[/h2]

Shortly before this year began, [b]Act 9 Part 1 – Secrets of the Undercity[/b] arrived, introducing new quests, levels, an underground world with new maps and monsters, two challenging raids, fresh gear, and an enhanced fairy system. With each new act, our goal is to continue expanding the wonderful world of NosTale and provide a new dose of fun, exploration, and exciting battles.

However, areas, instances, and enemies are not the only things we have worked on this first half of the year. In June, we released [b]Act 9 Part 2 – Heroes of the Undercity[/b], which brought a new generation of specialist cards with innovative mechanics and a new raid boss which will test your preparation for the end-game.

[h3]Quality of Life Changes[/h3]

With the latest update, we have implemented several modifications to various aspects and systems of the game. These include adjustments to Pollutus and Giant Arma’s mechanics, and better rewards in raid boxes from Act 8 and 9 raids. We have also increased the drop rates of several items such as Mystic Power Crystals and Moritius Obsidian, as well as upping the gold limit in the NosBazaar and player inventory, among other changes.

Many quality-of-life changes have been introduced with this release. Some updates contain more noticeable changes than others, but this remains an important aspect of every addition to the game, so we appreciate you continuing to send us your suggestions and ideas via Discord.

[h2]NosFire Event Servers[/h2]

This Easter we introduced a new kind of event – the NosFire temporary event server. This event server was designed to help returning and new players quickly catch up with end-game content. Thanks to your motivation, the first edition was an amazing success, and we greatly appreciate all your positive feedback about it. We will evolve it based on your comments for a future edition, also adding some more surprises to spice things up.

[h2]International Servers[/h2]

Recently, we also merged the two international servers to ensure a balanced population across all servers, although some might have preferred different plans.

While a mega-server with all communities might seem appealing, it would likely lead to overcrowding and a worse experience. Rest assured, the other servers remain well-populated, and we will continue to monitor server numbers closely.

[h1]Second Half of 2024: What to Expect[/h1]

For the second half of this year, you will notice some familiar content, some expected changes, as well as a few surprises. We want to ensure that the content we release meets both your expectations and our own high standards, so we won’t provide specific dates, just an overview. As we approach each release date, we will share more detailed information, so stay tuned to our channels!

NosTale is more alive than ever and will continue to receive updates actively. With all that said, here’s what’s coming in 2024!

[h2]Hardcore Raids[/h2]

The main novelty for the second half of this year will be Hardcore Raids, new content designed to test the skills of the most advanced players. The current game raids will have a version with increased difficulty, which will require special conditions to access.

Additionally, this update will include a series of changes to systems closely related to raids, such as an increased family level, new family achievements, and a renewed token shop with exciting rewards.

[h2]Summer Oasis[/h2]

Speaking of servers and merges, we can already inform you that this summer, a new special server will be available to welcome adventurers and help them progress faster. It will combine elements from NosFire, such as double events during weekends and the extra boosts that you enjoyed, along with a planned merge after a set period! This ensures that fresh characters are swiftly prepared for the hardcore raids, new specialists, and end-game challenges. More information will be provided as we approach the server launch.

[h2]Rework of Act 4[/h2]

We know how eager you were for the Act 4 update, so it is especially satisfying for us to announce its arrival in 2024. There are still many details to be finalised about the definitive content, so at the moment, we cannot offer you a preview of what it will entail. What we can tell you is that our goal with this update is to revitalise the act’s content, making it relevant again for players in both PvE and PvP.

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

As mentioned earlier, we greatly appreciate all the suggestions you send us on Discord. They are a valuable source of information about the state of the game and which content is most important for us to update and improve. Thanks to this feedback, we have prepared a series of quality-of-life improvements focused on some of the most relevant suggestions you have conveyed to us via the platform.

[h2]Seasonal Events[/h2]

And of course, we will continue to have our regular seasonal content, including Summer, Anniversary, Halloween, and Christmas events.

As always, we appreciate all the comments you share about the community updates, and we look forward to reading your impressions on Discord, Reddit, and the forums. All feedback is welcome!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Game Update: Become an Expert Pet Trainer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b0738846590b28dcb7cf7ae361e01073916bd40d.jpg[/img]

Get ready for the [b]new update on 23rd May 2023[/b]! Train your pets and become the best Pet Trainer in all of NosVille! Collect pets in your Pet Book, evolve them and receive unique rewards! Get started right away and visit [b]Pet Trainer Lucy in NosVille[/b]. Her Pet Trainer quest line will guide you through the first steps as a Pet Trainer. (You need to have reached at least level 80.)

[h3]New Lifestyle Specialist Card: Pet Trainer[/h3]

With the new specialist card, you can tame monsters and train them as pets in your Miniland to make them even stronger. Here’s how it works:
[list][*]Tame a monster or buy a pet.[/*][*]Summon various Sparring Monsters to train your pets.[/*][*]Depending on its training level, the pet has certain skills.[/*][*]When a pet has reached the maximum training level, you can increase its star rating with the Evolve skill (from 1 to 6 stars).[/*][*]To increase the star rating, you need the corresponding Pet Essence. (Example: If you want to upgrade a 2-star pet, you’ll need the Pet Essences of a 2-star pet.)[/*][*]To get Pet Essences, you need to tame and train another pet with the same star rating until it has reached its maximum training level.[/*][*]Extract the Pet Essence from the pet. (The pet is released in the process.)[/*][*]Now you can use the extracted Pet Essences and some gold to increase the star rating of the first pet.[/*][*]When you increase a pet’s star rating, it will forget all of its skills and the training level will be reset to 1, but at the same time its maximum training level will be increased.[/*][/list]
[h3]Tame Pets[/h3]
[list][*]Pet Trainers have two skills they can use to catch animals: ‘Tame’ and ‘Advanced Tame’. [/*][*]You can only tame 1 and 2-star creatures with skills. The Tame skill can be used for 1-star animals, while Advanced Tame is needed for 2-star animals.[/*][*]Advanced Tame needs a particular item for you to use it: Lure.[/*][*]Bring the necessary ingredients to Lucy in NosVille and she’ll craft Lure.[/*][/list]
[h3]Train Pets[/h3]
[list][*]To train your pets, you need to summon one of three various Sparring Monsters. For this you need a Sparring Monster Cage, which you can buy from Lucy.[/*][*]The first Sparring Monster trains your pets to level 20, the second to level 40 and the third to level 60.[/*][*]When a pet’s training level increases, its HP, attack power, defence, hit rate and all resistances increase as well. Plus at certain levels it can learn special skills.[/*][*]A pet can have a maximum of two additional skills. Any skills it has already learned can be upgraded at random.[/*][*]At training levels 10 and 20, the pet learns one new skill each. At further training levels (30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60), a skill that has already been learned is upgraded at random.[/*][/list]
[h3]Star Rating & Training Level[/h3]
[list][*]Every pet can evolve from 1 to 6 stars. Your training level depends on this (maximum training level = star rating x 10).[/*][*]You get a fixed stat per training level (e.g. defence, HP, attack, etc.)[/*][/list]
[h3]Pet Book[/h3]
[list][*]Here you can see which pets there are and which ones you have already collected and trained. [/*][*]In addition, there are missions that you can complete to receive special rewards. You can also complete daily quests here.[/*][/list]
[h3]Rewards[/h3]
[list][*]Titles: You will receive various titles for completing some of the quests from the Pet Book.[/*][*]Passive skill books: Some quests from the Pet Book reward you with passive skill books.[/*][/list]
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

Learn all about the content of the update in [url=https://board.en.nostale.gameforge.com/index.php?thread/11982-game-update-maintenance-23-05-2023/&postID=124968#post124968]our patch notes[/url]!

Best of luck on your way to becoming an expert trainer!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Update: Balancing for Specialist Cards
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/64e16e69ca7f645076651dfdccb5d1abcbd989a1.jpg[/img]

Heads up, NosHero! The next update arrives on 15th March 2023 – and along with it loads of exciting content: discover the new balancing for several specialist cards as well as a bunch of improved game features! Read on to find out everything you need to know.


[h1]Balancing for Specialist Cards[/h1]

Get ready for exciting battles, because the following specialist cards will receive improved balancing with the upcoming update:

[b]Master Wolf[/b]
The way his ultimate abilities work has been fundamentally changed so that each of them now serves an individual purpose. From now on, you collect points for each skill hit and receive the ‘Ultimate Aura’ by activating the ultimate skills. At the highest level, you can use your ‘Ultimate Tri-Combo’ to destroy your opponents!

[b]Holy Mage[/b]
The healing of the Holy Mage now scales with his own maximum HP: the stronger you are, the more you can heal your allies! In addition, some of his skills have been reworked to offer even more support in the fight against raid bosses.

[b]Crusader[/b]
The damage the Crusader receives from his Triple Charging has been slightly reduced. In return, his basic skill has been accelerated and turned into an area attack that can hurt several enemies at once. Additionally, his healing and the ‘Growing Shield’ skill have been reworked.

[b]Assassin[/b]
The Assassin can now deal critical damage to his opponents with his daggers for a longer period of time. In return, his burst damage has been slightly reduced.

[b]Dragon Knight[/b]
The Dragon Knight now heals when enemies attack his ‘Draconium Shield’ skill.

[b]Blaster[/b]
The buff duration of several skills has been slightly increased. In addition, his ‘Dragon’s Breath’ skill now triggers a buff for the player instead of debuffing the opponent.

[b]Gravity[/b]
The damage reduction of his mana shield has been slightly improved.

[b]Hydraulic Fist[/b]
The Hydraulic Fist now regains mana when enemies attack into his ‘Frontal Block’ skill.

[b]Archmage[/b]
The Archmage now heals himself only half as much as his allies.

[b]Scout[/b] 
The Scout now reduces less critical damage of incoming attacks.

[b]Seer[/b] 
The cooldown of the ‘Mind Sink’ skill has been increased. Additionally, the damage reduction of his mana shield has been weakened.

[b]Dark Gunner[/b]
The damage reduction of his mana shield has been significantly reduced.

[b]Berserker:[/b] 
The ‘Break Armour’ skill now reduces the enemy’s defence level by 5 instead of 7 levels.


[h1]Improved Game Features[/h1]

As already announced, this update also includes some more of the longed-for ‘Quality of Life’ improvements that should make your adventures in NosTale a little more enjoyable. The following improvements will be made to the game:

[list]
[*]The Asgobas raid has been revised: the difficulty of the antechambers has been reduced and you now have to defeat significantly fewer monsters in the raid.
[*]The Revenant Paimon raid has been revised: you can now no longer use mounts in the raid and some monsters can see invisible players. In return, you are now guaranteed an SP9 Perfection Stone after every raid.
[*]Raid entries are now only consumed when the respective raid has been successfully completed.
[*]Raid reward chests are now stacked in the inventory (instead of occupying one inventory slot per item). From them you get items with a random rare-level between R0 and R6. This does not affect particularly rare R7 and R8 chests: they remain as separate items.
[*]The cost of scrolls and resistances from the Act 8 raid token shop has been reduced.
[*]You can find the complete list of changes in the patch notes.
[/list]
Have fun, 
The NosTale Team

notes.title: UPDATE: Four New Specialists
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/a3b8b69794cedc0e51a1f5f732cd925f22382930.jpg[/img]

At the turn of the year, you can look forward to the biggest update in a long time: four brand new specialists are coming to NosTale – one for each class, as well as numerous quests and a thrilling raid! Read on to find out the most important details about the new content. First up, the new specialists:

[h2]The New Specialists[/h2]
Become the greatest hero in NosTale with one of the four brand new specialists. But first you must free the souls of the contenders. To do this, you’ll complete an exciting series of quests in which you hunt monsters and collect Time-Space Stones and other items. Which of the four new specialists will you free?

[h3]DRAGON KNIGHT for Swordsmen[/h3]
The Dragon Knight wields a mighty lance for which even dragon scales are no match. To go with it, he carries a shield that cannot be harmed by magic and can even withstand dragon’s breath. The Dragon Knight’s attacks fill up his ‘Polished Lance’ bar: the longer he brawls with his enemies, the stronger his attacks become. In addition, his skills enable him to pierce the armour of enemies, causing them to suffer great damage from his other skills.

[h3]BLASTER for Archers[/h3]
The Blaster carries a devastating cannon which can launch various grenades and take down even the toughest enemies. The longer he fires his cannon, the hotter it gets. This in turn gives him powerful additional effects that he can use to inflict further damage on his opponent. But if the Blaster’s weapon overheats, he cannot use any skills for a short time until it has cooled down again. By reloading regularly he can prevent overheating and even increase his damage.

[h3]GRAVITY for Mages[/h3]
Gravitas rules over gravity: with the help of his gravitational sphere, he manipulates gravity and antigravity to his advantage. Depending on which element he uses, the power of the respective element increases. When he has fully tamed the two forces of gravity and antigravity, he reaches gravitational equilibrium to unleash special bonus abilities for his skills.

[h3]HYDRAULIC FIST for Martial Artists[/h3]
While the Hydraulic Fist may have a weak physique, he makes up for it with his devastating metallic fists. The Hydraulic Fist’s robotic arms are Draconium gauntlets powered by a magical engine that helps them unleash their immense destructive force. By supplying sufficient fuel, his attacks are significantly strengthened and receive additional bonus effects.

[h2]The New Raid[/h2]
To upgrade your new specialist with Perfection Stones, you will face dangerous adversaries in a challenging boss room in the new raid. Prepare for battle! It definitely won’t be a piece of cake!

[h2]More New Content[/h2]
In addition to the new content mentioned above, you can expect additional quests and our winter events with brilliant rewards and festive offers. Keep your eyes peeled for our next news post and find out what Christmas in NosTale has in store for you!

Enjoy the new content!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update - Summer 2022
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello NosPlayers!

Time really flies when you’re having fun! With half of the year already behind us, it’s about time we had another round of ‘What’s going down in the world of NosTale over the coming months?’

But before we get down to it, just the usual quick note that the following are only plans that may be subject to change. It’s entirely possible that some things get pulled forward, while others end up on the back-burner, so please see this roadmap as a general guide of what lies ahead, rather than a set of commandments chiselled in stone.

With that out of the way, let’s get to it!

In general, balancing changes and quality of life improvements will continue to be released sporadically between larger updates. There’s more than enough work to be done here, and while we don’t want to nail ourselves to any specific changes, rest assured we won’t be running out things to improve any time soon.

We previously announced the next round of balancing changes which will concentrate on the Master Wolf, Holy Mage and Crusader specialists. A little further on the horizon will be the Warrior, Sunchaser and Mystic Arts.

If you’re one of those people who’d much rather decimate the local wildlife though, don’t worry, we’ve got you covered, with SP10 planned for the end of the year! That’s right, we’re looking to introduce a new specialist for every class. Such big content changes always require a lot of effort, so we can’t absolutely guarantee that this patch won’t be pushed back to the following year, but for now we’re definitely aiming at a 2022 release.

Even though we already had a round of server merges in the first half of the year, we’re planning more for the second half. This time will focus on those servers which didn’t need any change in the last round, but where activity has dropped off and the requests for a merge have become louder.
Please note that we’ll only go into more specific detail (regarding which servers and when etc.) at a later point in time. Because of its geographic location, merging the US server (EN2) is giving us some headaches which will need more time to iron out, so it’s possible that this server will not be part of the second round of merges.

As it’s been almost a year since the last new server launch, we’ll probably have some news on that front in the second half of the year, but again, more details will follow in due course.

As ever, there’ll be seasonal events to look forward to, and doubtless a few new items will find their way into the game. And let’s not forget that NosTale will pass a huge milestone and celebrate its 15th anniversary in October! That’s right, if we’re made to feel old, you have to share our pain!

And that about wraps up everything we have to tell! As already mentioned at the start, it’s entirely possible for some of these plans to get waylaid or for others to take their place.  But we hope this update at least gives you a flavour of the things to come.

Wishing you a (not too) warm and sunny summer!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Update: Specialist Partner Fusion & Wing Fusion
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/cbee6baf64337366ecc706fd0b0517bc35449a00.jpg[/img]

Not long now until 6th July, when you can start to explore the changes we wrote about in our [url=https://gameforge.com/en-GB/play/nostale/news/d5c413cc-0e2f-4791-9708-aa885bc3de7c]last post[/url]: [b]Specialist Partner Fusion[/b] and [b]Wing Fusion[/b]!

Specialist Partner Fusion is a new system which enables you to use the specialist partner cards you don’t need to upgrade the ones you do. Fusing them together gives your partners powerful bonuses!

Meanwhile, in the NosMall you can find the Wing Changer (Random), which gives you a certain chance to transfer the appearance of certain wings onto another pair. Keep the cool effects of the wings you have, while enjoying the looks of the wings which best suit your hero!

[h3]Trailer[/h3]
Check out the trailer for the update here:

[previewyoutube=1yiQZ3GnYMk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[b]Added the specialist partner fusion system.[/b]
[list][*]Specialist partner fusion allows you to upgrade your specialist partner cards by fusing unused cards with your main one. As with the familiar perfecting system you know from regular specialist cards, this permanently increases their stats.[/*][*]You can upgrade you specialist partners with every alchemist in the big towns.[/*][*]If you fuse your specialist partner card with an identical one, you’ll receive double the experience.[/*][*]An identical specialist partner card is even a requirement for upgrading from levels 19, 39, 59, 79 and 99. Exceeding these levels gives you a large amount of additional skill points.[/*][*]Temporary specialist partner cards and specialist partners with similar appearances (such as Foxy and Fiona) are considered copies for the purposes of the specialist partner fusion.[/*][*]When you upgrade your specialist partner card, it will randomly increase one of the following 8 stats: attack, defence, crit damage reduction, HP/MP, fire resistance, water resistance, light resistance or shadow resistance.[/*][*]The number of points depends on the card’s current upgrade level. In total you can receive up to 390 skill points, shared across all 8 stats, but you can never have more than 100 points in one main stat, or 35 points in a resistance stat.[/*][/list]
[b]Added a wing randomiser item.[/b]
[list][*]This was suggested by the players and was originally intended to be implemented as a wing fusion system. However, having thought more about the issue, we decided that few players would want to ‘waste’ an expensive pair of wings for the sake of a new appearance. So we’ve implemented this as a system which allows you to try out lots of different wing designs in the game, irrespective of their effects![/*][*]An option has been added to the specialist card interface which allows you to remove the current wing design.[/*][*]All buffs granted by specialist wings have their own buff symbol, making it easier to identify which wing effects are active.[/*][*]When using this item, you can't get the same wings twice in a row. You also won't receive the appearance of your currently equipped wings.[/*][/list]
[b]Added a Retro Wing randomiser item to the Rainbow Crystal shop.[/b]
[list][*]We also wanted to give you the option to try out the newly introduced Retro Wings in a separate package. Given the different colour variations, there was no easy way to include them in the regular wing fusion, without drowning out the other wing options. The next update is bringing two great changes to your favourite game: [b]Specialist Partner Fusion[/b] and [b]Wing Fusion[/b]!

Learn more details about what to expect below.

[h2]Specialist Partner Fusion[/h2]
To make sure your partners stay the distance and don’t wilt at the first sign of danger, we’re introducing a new system to the game in the form of the Specialist Partner Fusion. This allows you to make use of those specialist partner cards you don’t need, whilst simultaneously [b]strengthening your favourites[/b]!

Simply open the Specialist Partner Fusion menu, and drag in the partner card you want to improve and the one you want to use as a material. The only other thing required is a bit of gold, and some additional materials, depending on the current level of your card.

The fusion works best if you use the same cards, but other partner cards can be used to give your favourites a boost up to a certain level. Certain levels will however require that you use the same card for upgrading. The maximum level you can reach through Specialist Partner Fusion is [b]level 100[/b].

Fusing cards gives your specialists more HP, better defence, reduced damage from crits, and other [b]powerful bonuses[/b], depending on the level and experience of the specialist partner card you use as the material.

[h2]Wing Fusion[/h2]
Similar to the system for Mysterious Hair Dye, in the future you’ll find a new item in the NosMall – the [b]Wing Changer (Random)[/b]! This gives you a certain chance to transfer the appearance of your wings to another pair, allowing you to benefit from the powerful effects of one set of wings, while enjoying the appearance of a different set you prefer.

There’s a button on your specialist card allowing you to reset the original appearance for free, in case you ever have second thoughts about your choice. Please note that the wings newly added to the game will not be available for Wing Fusion.

notes.notes:

Hello NosPlayers!

As some of you may have noticed... it’s the start of a new year! And of course that means it’s time for another community update.

As the last update was around half a year ago now, here is a short explanation of what community updates are. For a while now, at the start and middle of the year, we send out a little note summarising any updates, changes, and ideas we’re considering for the months thereafter. 

Of course, nothing is set in stone, and sometimes plans are pushed back or forward. But this just gives you a good overview of what you can look forward to. The plans discussed in today’s update will cover the first half of 2022 (in no particular order). We’re looking forward to another wonderful year with you all!

Of course, the biggest point on the list is the second half of the Act 8 Update. As the main feature of 8.2., our plan is to introduce a champion level equivalent to the Land of Death, something that’s been requested for a while now. We also want to make some significant changes to runes and tattoos. As well as introducing new stuff (why exactly do runes only work on weapons?), we will also have to take a piercing gaze at a few things needing nerfs.

Another greatly awaited topic that we will be turning our minds to now the new year has started is merging more servers. The whos, whats and wherefores regarding this merge will all be made clear in separate news posts. For the moment, we just want you to know that we see and hear the calls for merges loud and clear, and are making preparations.

But servers aren’t the only things that will see some merging in the next 6 months! We’re currently in discussions with Entwell about a possible merge system for partners and wings: two areas that we know are very much hoped for by the community.

And of course we have to mention the hotly discussed balance patches, as they are absolutely still on the cards. The next pair we have planned are for Seers and Berserkers. We’re diligently pottering about making plenty of improvements.

Besides all of that, you can also look forward to another season of the battle pass, as well as all the usual seasonal events, and some fantastic new items (such as a pair of wings based on the winner of our last fan art competition).

As you can see, we’ve got plenty of things in the works. Let us know what you think of our ideas! We love to hear your opinions. You’ll be hearing from us in at most 6 months with another community update for you.

Wishing you the best possible start to your new year,
The NosTale Team

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello NosPlayers!

The second quarter of the year will end soon, and so it’s time for another community update.

In the last months, we were able to complete a number of our long-awaited projects and successfully merged databases and servers on an international level for the first time as well as launching new ones (any rumours about a 30-hour maintenance are wholly unfounded).
And after 13½ years, we’ve also finally learned how to cook, thereby displacing the conventional frozen pizza from the broader food meta.

But there are obviously two very specific projects you wanted to know about!
We all know what this is really about anyway, so we’ll set aside the annual outlook for the second half and get straight down to the nitty-gritty: SP9 and balancing – when’s it happening already?!

Entwell is currently concentrating entirely on the new Specialist Card and will likely present us with a first version before the end of June. However, we want to leave ourselves enough time to make any necessary changes to ensure you’ll be satisfied not only with the cards themselves but also everything to do with them. Based on this, we’re currently planning the release of SP9 for mid to late July. Of course, we’ll be dropping a few hints for you here or there in advance – the archer, for example, will be very spear-cial.

Balancing! We informed you in our last update that we’re preparing a test server so we can upload large balancing changes without putting the live environment at risk.
This project has since encountered a number of hurdles which make it impossible for us to implement it in a way we think it makes sense. While we will continue to pursue how to implement these servers in the background, you’ll still want to see changes, of course. 
And we’ll get them to you! – even if not all at once.

As we still do not want to take the risk of a single massive balancing update, we will roll out adjustments for individual specialists between content updates as often as possible.
We’ll start with the Death Reaper and Destroyer next week, followed up in the next round by the Fire Cannoneer and Tide Lords and Ladies.

Please let us know what you think about the changes. It won’t only help us in the following weeks, but also with any potential readjustments.

With these two topics out of the way, what else is planned for the rest of the year? At the moment, we’re totally focused on what we mentioned above, but here’s a little preview for you anyway!

As you can already see, we’re experimenting with a new type of event. This concerns a feature that we would like to expand to eventually provide daily, weekly and even seasonal quests and activities.

And of course we can’t leave out the new items in the form of costumes, pets, wings and more. Plus we’d like to make further adjustments to the EXP system, but we’ll talk more about that at a later date.

And finally, in case that wasn’t enough already, there miiight still be another large update hiding around the corner come the end of the year. It’s too early to clearly tell if and when or what that may be – for the moment, we can rest assured knowing there’ll be plenty more to talk about in our next, wonderful community update.

We’ll let that be all for now.

The exact changes to the Death Reaper and Destroyer will be announced separately in the coming days. Until then, we encourage you to keep an eye out for more SP9 teasers. 

We look forward to another, stupendous half year with you!
[i]With a 60-Hour Maintenance![/i]

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update – Merges and Balancing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello NosPlayers!

As we enter the final quarter of the year, we wanted to reach out and talk about what’s currently in the pipeline, what plans we have, and what problems lie ahead.

Today’s community update focuses on two main issues – the international server merges and the next balancing patch – and the reasons why neither is quite ready!

Last week we made the difficult decision to push the server merges we’d had pencilled down for November back into next year. We know that many of you will be annoyed to hear this, and we totally understand – in fact, nobody’s more put out by this than we are! Be that as it may, we want to be as open and frank as we can about both the reasons behind this decision, and where we’re going from here.

The aim of the server merges is to pool the smaller communities into a larger one, yet still allow each player to choose the language version they want to play the game in. NosTale currently has 9 completely separate setups and databases across all languages, making this project far more complicated than simply throwing together servers from within the same territory.

We need more time than originally budgeted for to ensure that no accounts slip through our digital fingers, and all the servers can be merged without a hitch. But enough of our excuses! Let’s come to what you really want to know: when are the merges coming? Well, if everything goes according to the current plan, we should be able to get this underway early next year. We don’t have a concrete date yet, but we’ll keep you posted as things progress.

What does all this have to do with the eagerly awaited balancing patch? Don’t worry, we haven’t forgotten about that. One request on a lot of players’ lips is for more and deeper-running changes. While we’ve already taken a number of steps in this direction, the last thing we want to do is release a patch which knocks everything out of kilter – and let’s be honest, that wouldn’t be the first time. So we’ve come up with another solution…

Introducing the Public Experimental Server for Testing Stuff (or PESTS – okay, fine, the name is still WIP)!

That’s right, we want to hear your feedback to any changes we make as directly as we can, so we’re working on setting up a public test server where you can try out all our experimental tweaks and adjustments first hand. It’s important to us that everyone has a fair say, so we didn’t want make this an exclusively English server. Once the international merges are complete, we plan to roll out an international server as a test playground, where everyone can mess around and play with all the toys.

But that’s why the next big balancing patch is directly linked to the server merges.

Fine, so is there anything coming out this year?! Don’t worry, we’ve still got plenty in the pipeline to publish over the next few months. Keep your breath baited and fish around for clues, and you might even find a few hints about the next specialist coming to NosVille.

As ever, we’d like to thank you for being patient, and apologise for these delays. You’re what makes NosTale so amazing even after 13 years, and we cannot thank you enough. Have a great October and see you next update!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: [28/3/2018] Your Changes in the Latest Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/5e0e7239c38e17cbce3c320745a45e9e4a40317c.jpg[/img]

On 28th March 2018 we’ll be releasing a patch which was only possible thanks to your feedback! We’ve implemented many of your changes and suggestions to make NosTale even easier to play.

[b]These are the changes you requested which have now been implemented in the game:[/b]

- You can now only write messages only hitting the character limit. Try to type more characters than that and they will not appear.
- There is now a 5 second cooldown between sending repeated party, friendship, family and trade requests.
-  As soon as you’re invited to join a family, the remaining time to join will be displayed (if set).
- The maximum limit for a stack is now 999.
- A button labelled ‘Continuous Production’ has been added for crafting items. This allows production to continue automatically until there are insufficient materials in your inventory.
- The levelsof raid members has been removed to make names more visible. If you want to see their levels, you can still simply hover over the character’s picture.
- The costume inventory has been expanded to 60 slots.
- An additional character slot has been added, however this is not yet usable.
- Buffs and healing no longer interrupt other players’ transformations.
- Fafnir’s Fried Dinner no longer requires confirmation before use.
- Using items from the NosMall now requires confirmation to reduce the chance of them being used by mistake.
- The production window no longer disappears after an item has been crafted.

[b]We’ve also made some changes to the interface:[/b]

- The raid interface for Acts 4 and 6 has been scaled down.
- The skill bars have been moved and the experience bars now appear at the bottom of the screen.
- It is now possible to drag equipment into the skill bar and use it from there.
- The skill bar can be locked which prevents skills or equipment being removed accidentally.
- Individual elements can now be moved to suit your needs. This feature can be activated and deactivated. It is currently not possible to lock the position of the UI elements, but we’re working on implementing this as well.
- The skill bar now has more slots, changing the key bindings as follows:

        Top row: numbers 1 to 0
        Second row: CTRL+1 to CTRL+0
        Third row: ALT+1 to ALT+0
        Partner skills are now bound to the keys Q, W, E and R.
        The user interface can be activated/deactivated with the shortcut CTRL+X.
        The graphics resolution can be changed with the shortcuts SHIFT+F1 through SHIFT+F7.


We look forward to hearing more excellent ideas and feedback from you, and will endeavour to implement them as best we can.

The NosTale Team
